title: Formalizing Formal Semantics: The Formal Atlas
abstract: arXiv:2611.19509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we present the Formal Atlas, a system for the study of natural language semantics using proof assistants. Our aim is to formalize semantic accounts,   check their predictions and compare the implemented theories. To this end, we connect source records and formal developments with an interactive application, where   researchers can inspect proofs and modify supported Rocq files. Montague's PTQ and Gallin provide our main cases, followed by dynamic and type-theoretic   comparisons, RSA and distributional semantics. We also discuss what it takes to formalize less explicit analyses. Lastly, we consider the use of AI, both for   assistance in developing these resources and for inference systems that can make use of them. This work extends an earlier programme in proof-assistant semantics,   with research and teaching as complementary uses.

translated_title: 形式语义学的形式化：形式图谱
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了形式图谱，这是一个使用证明助手研究自然语言语义的系统。我们的目标是形式化语义分析、检验其预测并比较所实现的理论。为此，我们通过一个交互式应用程序将文献来源记录与形式化工作连接起来，研究人员可以在其中查看证明并修改受支持的 Rocq 文件。蒙塔古的 PTQ 与 Gallin 的著作为我们提供了主要案例，随后是动态语义与类型论语义的比较、RSA 以及分布式语义。我们还讨论了形式化那些不够显式的分析所需的条件。最后，我们探讨了人工智能的应用，既可用于辅助开发这些资源，也可用于能够利用这些资源的推理系统。这项工作扩展了早期证明助手语义学的研究计划，研究与教学是其互补的用途。
tldr: 本文提出了基于证明助手的“形式图谱”系统，通过交互式应用将语义学文献与形式化证明连接起来，实现语义理论的形式化、预测检验与比较，并探索AI辅助开发与推理的应用前景。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Formal Atlas, a proof-assistant-based system that connects semantic literature with interactive formal developments to formalize, verify, and compare natural language semantic theories, while also exploring AI-assisted development and inference.
